h1: Diamond Plaza Hotel Surat Thani — the downtown high-rise travellers passing through still book again
intro: If you are about to cross over to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, or simply need a night in central Surat Thani, the name Diamond Plaza Hotel is one locals know well · It is a 20-storey tower on Sriwichai Road that has been open since 2001 · This is not a sleek new boutique stay, but a large city hotel with 400-plus rooms, an outdoor pool, gym, free parking, and a location near the malls — from around ฿700/night · Real guest reviews agree it is good value for what it is, as long as you know what you are booking.

body.html: Diamond Plaza Hotel has been operating since 2001 and is one of the tallest, most familiar buildings to Surat Thani residents · It sits on Sriwichai Road in Makham Tia, near Central Plaza and Lotus · A major renovation in 2019 freshened parts of it, but the overall feel is still that of an older hotel · This is not a design-led boutique stay — it is a 20-storey city hotel with 400-plus rooms that does its job well, with everything a one- or two-night guest needs.

Rooms range from Deluxe Twin/Double (24–32 sqm) up to Junior Suite and President Suite · What surprises many guests is that the rooms are cleaner than the building's exterior suggests — "old building but very clean room" comes up often in reviews · Rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable, hot-water pressure is good, and Wi-Fi is fast enough for streaming · The trade-off is dated furniture and decor that hasn't kept up with newer hotels.

"The building looks old from outside so I didn't expect much, but the room was clean, the bed comfortable, the air-con cold and the staff helpful — at this price in central Surat Thani it's more than fair."

One thing reviewers consistently praise is the large, clear outdoor swimming pool, which has a separate children's pool — handy for families travelling with kids · There is also a gym, a massage room and a grand, spacious lobby · The restaurant serves Thai food and a breakfast buffet · Breakfast reviews are mixed — some find it varied and tasty, others say it's gone cold if you arrive late or the spread is smaller than expected · A local tip is to walk across the street for a Surat-style dim sum breakfast, easy to find around here.

Location is the main reason people choose it · It's on Sriwichai Road near Central Plaza and Lotus, within walking distance of the mall · It's an especially convenient base for anyone about to take the road transfer to the Don Sak pier to cross over to Koh Samui or Koh Phangan · The hotel offers airport transfers and helps book tours and ferry tickets · Be aware, though, that this area sits a little outside the old town centre — nights are quiet and there isn't much to see right around it, so most people stay here in transit rather than to explore the city.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: Diamond Plaza is an older property that is reasonably maintained, but not every room is in the same condition · Some reviews mention thin walls and noise from the next room, motorcycle noise in road-facing rooms, and the occasional rattling air-con · If you hit a problem, ask to change rooms — reviews say staff are helpful · Guests who are disappointed usually expected a brand-new 4-star standard, while those who understand they're booking a long-running, budget-friendly 3-star city hotel tend to be satisfied.

In short, if you want an affordable place in central Surat Thani with a pool, a restaurant and free parking, and a location that makes onward road and ferry connections easy — and you're relaxed about modern design — Diamond Plaza delivers · Its 9.0 score from 146 Trip.com reviews captures the picture accurately: "good value, good location, old but clean" · It works best as a one-night stopover before island-hopping, rather than a destination in itself.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a higher-floor room that doesn't face the road when booking or at check-in — interior rooms are much quieter and don't catch the motorcycle noise from Sriwichai Road · And if you're up early, don't rely on the hotel buffet alone — walk across the street for local dim sum, the breakfast Surat Thani residents actually eat.

honestSummary: Diamond Plaza is the best pick for travellers who want an affordable, full-facility city base in central Surat Thani — near the malls, with a good pool, free parking and easy onward road and ferry connections · But understand it opened in 2001 and was only partly renovated, so room quality is not consistent throughout.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new, modern 4-star hotel — this is a 2001 building renovated in 2019, with an older feel → if newness matters to you, look at a more modern property

If you're coming to explore Surat Thani city as your main destination — the Sriwichai Road area sits outside the old centre, quiet at night with little around → if you're focused on the islands, use this as a one-night stopover then cross over
If you're a light sleeper — walls are fairly thin and road-facing rooms catch motorcycle noise → ask for a higher-floor interior room away from Sriwichai Road when you book

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Diamond Plaza Hotel Surat Thani

faq.q: Where is Diamond Plaza Hotel in Surat Thani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Diamond Plaza Hotel is at 83/27 Sriwichai Road, Makham Tia, in central Surat Thani · It's a 200 m walk to Lotus and about a 5-minute drive to Central Plaza, with a local dim sum spot across the street · It's roughly a 1-hour drive from Don Sak pier for the Koh Samui crossing and about 25 minutes from Surat Thani Airport.

faq.q: How much does Diamond Plaza Hotel cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿700/night for a Deluxe Twin/Double (24–32 sqm) · A Deluxe Triple runs about ฿1,000 and a Junior Suite around ฿1,400 · Prices vary by date and platform — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Is Diamond Plaza Hotel old? Are the rooms clean?
faq.a: It opened in 2001 and was renovated in 2019, so the building and decor still feel dated · Most reviews say the rooms are cleaner than the exterior suggests, with comfortable beds and good hot water · The caveats are that room condition is inconsistent and walls are fairly thin, so ask for a higher-floor interior room.

faq.q: Who is Diamond Plaza Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers who want an affordable city base before continuing by road and ferry to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · It's family-friendly thanks to the pool and kids' pool · It's not for those after a modern design hotel, or those treating Surat Thani city as a main destination.

faq.q: Does Diamond Plaza Hotel have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — there's a large outdoor pool with a separate kids' pool, frequently praised in reviews, plus a gym and massage room · Breakfast is a buffet at the restaurant, with mixed reviews — varied on some days, limited on others — so many guests walk across the street for dim sum instead.

faq.q: Is it convenient to reach the Koh Samui ferry from Diamond Plaza Hotel?
faq.a: Very · The hotel is central, and staff can book your ferry tickets and a transfer to Don Sak pier (about a 1-hour drive) to cross to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · This is the main reason many guests stay here for a night before island-hopping.
